seo_article_outline.title: Tell HN: Scribd Breached
sections: ปัญหาหรือคำถามที่ผู้อ่านต้องการคำตอบ
ข้อมูลพื้นฐานและข้อเท็จจริงที่ตรวจสอบได้
ทางเลือกหรือขั้นตอนที่ผู้อ่านนำไปใช้ได้
ข้อจำกัดและสิ่งที่ควรตรวจสอบเพิ่มเติม
สรุปและขั้นตอนถัดไป
seo_article_outline.source_summary_for_editor: Not seeing anything posted about this anywhere, received on Monday, 26th of Oct 2026: Subject: Notice of Security Incident This notice is being sent on behalf of Scribd, Inc., the parent company of Scribd, Slideshare, Everand, and Fable, by Epiq, Scribd Inc.’s notification partner. Hello, We are writing to let you know that Scribd, Inc. recently experienced a security incident that may have affected your data. We detected that an unauthorized third party may have gained access to certain user data in one of our systems. After investigating this activity, we found that the third party may have accessed your email address and the following of your information: last 4 digits of your credit card and country, credit card issuer, credit card expiry date, payment history (not including credit card details). We have no evidence that this data has been misused, but we are notifying you out of an abundance of caution so that you can take steps to protect your information. Watch for phishing We
